name: PRIME_FACTORIZATION_TARGET
description: Replaced the global sum constraint (which evaluated to an extremum, allowing bypass) with a global product constraint that targets a specific prime power. The possible edge contributions are 3, 7, and 12, and the target product is 7^m. Since 7 is strictly between 3 and 12, it is not an extremum, defeating models that rely on convex optimization or max/min shortcuts. The unique prime factorization of 7 forces every edge to contribute exactly 7, preserving the bipartite requirement and the exact same answers.
